\subsection*{Open Problem Registry (OPR) Summary}

This section summarizes the status of open derivation problems tracked during
Book 2 development. The OPR system ensures epistemic transparency by explicitly
marking what is derived [Der], conditionally derived [Dc], or postulated [P].

\subsubsection*{Scale Taxonomy}

Four distinct length/energy scales appear in the EDC weak-sector framework:

\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{@{}llll@{}}
\toprule
Symbol & Name & Physical Role & Status \\
\midrule
$\Delta$ & Kink width & Scalar wall microphysics: $\phi = v \tanh(\xi/\Delta)$ & [M] \\
$\delta$ & Boundary-layer & Transport/diffusion regularization for Robin BC & [P] \\
$\ell$ & Domain support & Sturm--Liouville interval for OPR-21: $\mu = M_0\ell$ & [P] \\
$R_\xi$ & Diffusion scale & Coordinate/correlation length: $R_\xi = \hbar c/M_Z$ & [BL] \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}

% --- Assumption Labels ---
\subsubsection*{Assumption Labels (A1--A3)}

\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{@{}lll@{}}
\toprule
ID & Assumption & Use Case \\
\midrule
(A1) & $\Delta = \delta$ & Kink width = boundary-layer scale \\
(A2) & $\delta = R_\xi$ & Boundary-layer = diffusion scale \\

\textbf{Rule}: No derivation may silently assume any of (A1)--(A3).
